{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
sales['revenue_clean'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter for LOYAL customers and completed orders
loyal_completed = sales[
    (sales['customer_segment'] == 'loyal') & 
    (sales['status'] == 'completed')
]

# Check if any QA orders are in this subset
qa_in_loyal_completed = loyal_completed[loyal_completed['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99]

# Check if any refunded orders are in this subset
refunded_in_loyal_completed = loyal_completed[loyal_completed['status'] == 'refunded']

# Compute mean revenue
mean_revenue = loyal_completed['revenue_clean'].mean()

# Print results
print(f"Number of LOYAL completed orders: {len(loyal_completed)}")
print(f"QA orders in LOYAL completed: {len(qa_in_loyal_completed)}")
print(f"Refunded orders in LOYAL completed: {len(refunded_in_loyal_completed)}")
print(f"Mean revenue (USD): {mean_revenue:.2f}")"}
